# Roll & Charge Mobile Tire

> Mobile tire service and tire & rim sales for Oakville & Burlington, Ontario. We come to the customer's home, office, or roadside. Every price is published. 45-Day Ride Promise on all work.

## Services & published pricing (CAD, +HST)
- Seasonal Tire Swap (on rims): $139 — second vehicle same visit: $79
- Tire Changeover (off rims, mount + balance + TPMS reset): $229 — second vehicle: $159
- Flat Tire Repair (internal plug-and-patch): $119
- Wheel Balancing (4 wheels): $99
- Seasonal Tire Storage: $119/season — Swap & Store Bundle: $239
- Spare Tire Install: $99
- New Tires & Rims: by quote, written-quote price match, all major brands
- Run-flats & wheels over 20": +$10/tire
- EV-safe service: lift-point pucks, EV torque specs (Tesla, Polestar, Ioniq, Mach-E), OE acoustic tires

## Facts
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8am–6pm, Sat–Sun 9am–5pm
- Service area: Oakville & Burlington, ON
- Fully insured. Calibrated torque wrench on every lug, free re-torque check.
- Guarantee: 45-Day Ride Promise — any issue tied to our work within 45 days is fixed free.
